channel.title: Blog Ovia
channel.description: AI, automation and security for professional firms and SMEs in Italy.

item.title: AI Agents & Data Risks: What Can Go Wrong for Your Firm
item.description: AI agents publishing data, accessing unauthorised systems, exposing clients: what has actually happened and what controls professional firms and SMEs need now.

item.title: AI Voice-Cloning Fraud: How to Protect Your Firm
item.description: AI voice-cloning fraud: the Fideuram €36 m case is a wake-up call. Learn to spot fake calls and set up the procedures your firm or business needs right now.

item.title: AI Agents: Security Risks for Your Firm
item.description: AI agent security risks: from the OpenAI–Australia case to real data breaches. What professional firms and SMEs are exposed to, and how to protect yourself. Practical guide.

item.title: Verifying AI output in professional firms: who signs off?
item.description: AI produces documents in seconds, but who checks them? The real risk for a professional firm isn’t the tool: it’s delegating judgement and responsibility.

item.title: Italian Law 132/2025: AI in professional firms and client disclosure
item.description: Italian Law 132/2025, art. 13: what accountants, lawyers and consultants using AI must do, how to inform clients and how to stay compliant.

item.title: AI Overviews: −58% clicks. What changes for your firm’s website
item.description: With Google’s AI Overviews the top result loses 58% of its clicks. What it means for a professional firm or SME website and how to get cited by AI.

item.title: Lead response time: why the first 60 minutes matter
item.description: Replying to a new enquiry within an hour makes qualification 7 times more likely. HBR and MIT data, and how to apply them in a firm without hiring anyone.
